This leaks the categorical distribution of the test set into the training features, which can artificially inflate performance metrics or cause the model to overfit to the test set's distribution.

summary: The agent implements a generally strong solution for the Allstate Claims Severity task, correctly applying log transformations, custom Fair loss, and extensive feature engineering. However, it fails to perform basic data cleaning, uses a naive equal-weight average for ensembling its CV folds, and leaks test set distribution information into the training data by calculating frequency encodings on the combined train-test dataframe.
